claim_boundary: The V98 validation machinery is implemented and CI-verified, but no successful-compromise lead-time claim is certified until a real disjoint campaign supplies a model-emitted warning and an objective successful-compromise event satisfying this contract.

legacy_evidence_excluded.reason: V93 measures lead time to an attack-step/onset boundary. An attack-step/onset timestamp is not an objective successful-compromise timestamp.

repository_audit.audit_conclusion: No currently checked-in paired real warning + objective successful-compromise event satisfies V98. The validator is ready to certify one when such campaign evidence is acquired.

required_for_pass: Use one explicitly identified real evidence campaign whose identity is disjoint from train, validation, calibration, and development-reused campaign identities.
Record an actual model-emitted warning JSON with campaign_id, event_id, timezone-aware timestamp, emitted_by_model=true, and model_identity.sha256.
Record an objective successful-compromise JSON for the same campaign with campaign_id, event_id, timezone-aware timestamp, establishes_successful_compromise=true, and a non-empty objective_basis.
Provide campaign provenance with identity_proof_complete=true and no overlap with prior fitting/reuse identities.
Run garuda_v3/v107_precompromise_evidence_validator.py and freeze the resulting PASS manifest plus all raw SHA-256 identities.
